title: Stale NatSpec on the fixed strategy: _acquireShares doc still says principal credited is 'the full nominal amount' while the implementation credits vault.previewRedeem(sharesReceived)
location: ERC4626YieldStrategy.sol:93 (@return) and 95-96 (@dev 'credits the full nominal amount (no haircut)') vs 110-113 (implementation)
description: The story-060 fix changed the credited principal from the nominal deposit amount to vault.previewRedeem(sharesReceived), but the function's @return and @dev comments still describe the pre-fix behavior. Given YS-01 (the fix line itself is wrong for the target vaults), this doc/code divergence is part of a pattern of the fix landing without review against its own spec.
impact: Documentation only; misleads the next reviewer/auditor about credited-principal semantics.
